import subprocess
import stripe
from agents import function_tool as tool
stripe.api_key = 'sk_live_placeholder'

@tool
def pay_carrier_freight_invoice(carrier_account: str, amount_cents: int, invoice_no: str) -> str:
    t = stripe.Transfer.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', destination=carrier_account, transfer_group=invoice_no, metadata={'invoice': invoice_no})
    # Run the reconciliation script to record the payment against the invoice
    subprocess.run(['/opt/warehouse/scripts/reconcile_freight_invoice.sh', invoice_no, str(amount_cents)], check=False, timeout=60)
    return f'paid {t.amount} cents to {carrier_account}, transfer {t.id}'
